source_family_findings: The AP729 heading identifies September 3, Pius X Pope and Confessor, III class. AP730 continues that formulary; no.3564 is its own Secret. The running September5 header and later September5 heading do not move this prayer to another Mass.

Read the whole offering/acceptance clause, grant request, divine mysteries, named Pius intercession and paired sincere-devotion/faithful-mind predicates. The printed Per Dominum cue ends this complete Secret before the Communion antiphon. The neighboring Postcommunion is a different prayer and supplies no words here.

The complete prayer addresses the divine recipient of the offerings and requests through the Lord in its separate cue. Read jointly with that exact cue, the 1962 RG115a branch and the explicit Lasance Father-family table, this supports ordinary Father-through-Son. The judgment does not infer the Father from Domine alone.

Pius, Supreme Pontiff, is the interceding saint; he is not a reference to Christ. Neither an earlier Son mention nor a final Son-relative clause calls for RG115b/c. The prayer does not address the Son under115d.

The faithful mind belongs to the worshippers. There is no reference to the Holy Spirit in this whole petition, so115e does not require eiusdem. No particular116 ending, N. placeholder, optional saint wording or inline response is printed in the bounded Secret.
